kbmi.loc: PDF p. 280, Leverage Ratio (bank only) qualitative analysis: 'Total Modal Inti sebesar Rp6,35 triliun' (Q4 2025); PDF p. 199, capital table (Tier 1 ratio 13.95% x RWA Rp45,550bn, bank only)
kbmi.note: INFERRED, not stated: AR2025 contains no sentence giving the bank's KBMI class. Bank-only core capital (Tier 1) of Rp6.35tn at 31 Dec 2025 is inside the KBMI 2 band (Rp6tn to <Rp14tn, POJK 12/POJK.03/2021). It only crossed Rp6tn because of the Rp3tn perpetual subordinated loan from KB Kookmin (AT1, June 2025); at 31 Dec 2024 bank Tier 1 was ~Rp3.4tn (KBMI 1 band) and AR2022 p. 123 says the bank was KBMI 1 in 2022. 30 Sep 2026 bank Tier 1 is Rp6,017.8bn (9M2026 published report p. 6), barely above the threshold. Reviewer: confirm with OJK if possible.

validation_ack.reason: Reported FY2023 basic loss per share (-61) uses the WEIGHTED-AVERAGE share count of 98,277,584,070 (FY2023 audited FS Note 48, PDF p. 230), because the PUT VII rights issue added 119,999,999,692 shares in May-June 2023 (ex-rights 16 May 2023). Year-end shares are 187,887,539,870, so EPS x year-end shares overstates the loss (-11,461bn vs -6,034bn). -6,034.077bn / 98.2776bn shares = -61.4. Source: https://api.kbbank.co.id//Hubungan%20Investor/Laporan%20Keuangan/Laporan%20Keuangan%20Triwulan/Triwulan%202023/Triwulan%20IV/PT%20Bank%20KB%20Bukopin%20Tbk_31%20Dec-23_Final_Released.pdf

research_notes: IDENTITY: legal name PT Bank KB Indonesia Tbk since 11 Aug 2025 (AGMS 28 May 2025 approved the change; OJK approval; AR2025 PDF pp. 73, 410). Formerly PT Bank Bukopin Tbk (until Feb 2021) and PT Bank KB Bukopin Tbk (2021-Aug 2025). Brand 'KB Bank' since 3 Mar 2024 (AR2025 PDF p. 20). Controlling shareholder KB Kookmin Bank Co., Ltd. (66.88% at 30 Sep 2026; STIC Eugene Star Holdings 16.98%), FY2025 FS Note 27a / 9M2026 FS PDF p. 165. Ticker unchanged: BBKP.

SOURCE ACCESS: www.kbbank.co.id is a React app whose documents are served by its own API host api.kbbank.co.id (listing endpoint https://api.kbbank.co.id/backend/api/v1/reports?cat=...). Every PDF was downloaded directly from api.kbbank.co.id with curl (no bot protection, no Internet Archive needed). URLs contain spaces, stored %20-encoded; the double slash after the host is part of the URLs the site itself serves.

SCOPE: consolidated figures include PT Bank KB Bukopin Syariah (95.92%, the sharia subsidiary; KB Bank itself is conventional, so sharia=false and no label overrides) and PT KB Bukopin Finance (99.24%). In FY2025 KB Bukopin Finance was classified as a discontinued operation / held for sale (sale agreements of 30 Jun / 1 Jul 2025: 85% to JB Woori Capital and 14.24% to other third parties; its assets sit in 'Aset yang dimiliki untuk dijual' within other assets; FY2025 FS Notes 1c and 55, PDF pp. 24, 238), so the FY2025 P&L shows continuing vs discontinued results and FY2024 was re-presented the same way (profit attributable unchanged).

LOSS YEARS ARE REAL: net profit attributable FY2020 -3,255.9bn, FY2021 -2,282.2bn, FY2022 -5,027.5bn, FY2023 -6,034.1bn, FY2024 -6,329.1bn; FY2025 +65.9bn (first profit since FY2019); 9M2026 -184.2bn. Negative EPS, ROA and ROE are as printed. Ratios outside the validator's plausible ranges that are REAL (validator warnings, not errors): ROE FY2022 -82.58%, FY2023 -61.38%, FY2024 -154.60% (bank-only loss Rp7.38tn while Tier 1 fell to ~Rp3.4tn); CIR FY2020 203.18%, FY2021 339.88%, FY2022 193.05%, FY2023 170.20%; BOPO FY2022 226.22%, FY2023 223.24%; LAR FY2021 65.12%. Each is printed in at least two company documents (see the note on each datum). The interim 'YTD profit YoY' warning is also real (9M2025 profit +288.1bn, 9M2026 loss -184.2bn).

RATIO BASIS: all FY ratios are bank only (OJK 'Rasio Keuangan' tables), taken from the most recent AR that prints the year: AR2025 for FY2023-FY2025, AR2024 for FY2022, AR2023 for FY2021, AR2022 for FY2020; values were cross-checked against each year's own AR and agree except FY2022 CAR (19.24% originally, restated to 19.08% in AR2023/AR2024 - the restated value is stored). CIR is missing from the AR2020-AR2023 tables and was taken from the PUT VII prospectus (FY2021) and the audited Dec-2020 published report (FY2020). CASA: OJK/AR tables for FY2020, FY2023, FY2024; FY2024 earnings deck table for FY2021-FY2022; FY2025 deck chart for FY2025 (all bank only). LAR: AR text for FY2021-FY2023 and FY2025, FY2024 deck table for FY2024; the FY2025 deck shows a restated (~0.5-0.7pt lower) series, not used. Cost of credit is not disclosed in any document (null, never computed); NPL coverage only for FY2020 (70.04%, AR2020 text).

DECK CHART VALUES: the FY2025 earnings-deck values (CASA 32.08%, LAR series) were read from chart labels and verified by rendering the page (pdftoppm). The deck's own CAR chart (FY24 16.87%, FY25 16.25%) differs from the AR (16.38%, 16.24%); AR values are used. NOTE: the IR listing entry 'Materi Perusahaan - 5M2024' (BBKP Corporate Presentation - 5M2024_1.pdf) now serves a byte-identical copy of the FY2025 deck, so the 5M2024 deck itself is unavailable.

EPS / SHARES: no stock split, reverse split or bonus issue since 2019 (AR2025 PDF p. 35 states no split/reverse split/bonus/par change in 2025; the share-history table in every FS Note 1d lists only rights issues and one private placement; par values Rp10,000 Class A / Rp100 Class B unchanged). Share count path: 11,651,908,748 (FY2019) -> +4,660,763,499 PUT V (Jul 2020) -> +16,360,578,947 private placement to KB Kookmin (2 Sep 2020) = 32,673,251,194 (FY2020) -> +35,214,288,984 PUT VI (Dec 2021) = 67,887,540,178 (FY2021, FY2022) -> +119,999,999,692 PUT VII (Jun 2023) = 187,887,539,870 (FY2023 onward, still at 30 Sep 2026). FY2020 and FY2021 EPS were computed by the bank on YEAR-END shares (not weighted average) so EPS x shares matches profit; FY2023 EPS uses the weighted average 98,277,584,070 (validation_ack). FY2025 EPS is null: the FS prints only continuing (0.66) and discontinued (-0.31) EPS. share_basis = period end for all FY per-share values (no split ever happened, so no adjustment applies).

CORPORATE ACTIONS (for corporate_actions.json): 3 rights issues - PUT V ex 2020-07-09 (5:2 @Rp180), PUT VI ex 2021-11-17 (200,000,000:215,554,239 @Rp200), PUT VII ex 2023-05-16 (100,000,000:176,762,922 @Rp100). The 2 Sep 2020 non-pre-emptive private placement (PMTHMETD) of 16,360,578,947 Class B shares to KB Kookmin Bank (EGMS 25 Aug 2020, RUPSLB summary at https://api.kbbank.co.id//Hubungan%20Investor/RUPS/2020/Publikasi%20Ringkasan%20Risalah%2020200825%20RUPS%20LB.pdf; FY2025 FS Note 1d) is not a rights/bonus issue and is not in the table. None of these changes the split factor. PRICE CHECK HINT: Yahoo may have scaled its history for the three rights issues (PUT VI and PUT VII were priced well below the market); the AR year-end closes are 2020: 575, 2021: 270, 2022: 102, 2023: 80, 2024: 54, 2025: 77.

DIVIDENDS: none paid out of FY2020-FY2025 profit (dividends: []). FY2020-FY2024 were loss years (AGMS agendas had no profit-appropriation item; AR2021 p. 153, AR2023 p. 173, AR2025 p. 215 say no dividend). FY2025: AGMS 25 Jun 2026 approved the use of net profit with no dividend; news (industry.co.id 29 Jun 2026) reports all profit retained. The KB Bank IR dividend history (api.kbbank.co.id/backend/api/v1/dividen, shown at kbbank.co.id/dividen) lists FY2014 as the last cash dividend. payout_ratio is stored as 0 for FY2020-FY2025; the validator's 'FY2025: no dividend records' warning is therefore expected.

NO RESTATEMENTS of the stored levels: each FY's total assets, loans, deposits, equity and profit equal the comparative printed in the following year's audited FS (FY2019-FY2024 checked). Minor reclassifications between related-party and third-party loan/interbank lines do not change totals.

INTERIM: 9M2026 (30 Sep 2026) consolidated FS ('Long Report') and the OJK published report were both on the IR site (listing dated 30-09-2026). The 9M2026 FS has sloppy text (balance-sheet share-count wording copied from 2023, EPS comparative column copied from FY2025), but the money figures tie to the published report and Note 27a; the stored values come from the primary statements and Note 27a. Prior-year comparatives (loans, deposits, profit) are from the 9M2025 FS as originally reported.

KBMI: stored as 2 by inference (bank-only Tier 1 Rp6.35tn at end-2025, Rp6.02tn at 30 Sep 2026, vs the Rp6tn KBMI 2 floor); the AR does not state the class and AR2022 said KBMI 1 for 2022. Doubtful - see the kbmi note.
